 Xiaomi confirms Android 17 HyperOS 4 rollout schedule for these devices
 Nicholas Sutrich  | Nov 3 2026 - 6:54 am PT 
 1 Comment 
 Several Xiaomi, Redmi, and Poco phones are getting the Android 17 HyperOS 4 update starting today.
 Xiaomi announced its Android 17-based HyperOS 4 update back in August, launching the beta for many of the company’s phones almost immediately. Now, the final version of the update is ready to launch for a bevy of models, starting today, November 3, 2026.
 In a post on X , Xiaomi detailed the full launch schedule, which includes:
 Rollout starting now
 Xiaomi 17/17T series
 Xiaomi 15
 Xiaomi Pad 8 series
 Poco F8 series
 Poco X8 series
 Poco M8 series
 Poco C85
 Poco C95 Pro
 Redmi Note 17 series
 Redmi Note 15 series
 Redmi 17 series
 Redmi 15 series
 If you don’t see the update yet, don’t worry. These things are always slowly rolled out in waves to catch any major problems before they become widespread. Xiaomi will be updating devices as old as 2022’s Xiaomi 13T. Here’s the full list:
 Advertisement - scroll for more content 
 Update starting mid-November 2026
 Xiaomi 15T series
 Xiaomi Pad 7 series
 Xiaomi Pad Mini
 Redmi Pad 2 series
 Poco Pad X1
 Poco Pad M1
 Poco F9 series
 Poco F7 series
 Poco X7 series
 Update starting in December 2026
 Xiaomi MIX Flip
 Xiaomi 14 series
 Xiaomi 14T series
 Xiaomi 13 series
 Xiaomi 13T series
 Xiaomi Pad 6S Pro 12.4
 Redmi Note 14 series
 Redmi 15 series
 Redmi 14S
 Redmi A7 Pro
 Redmi Pad 2 series
 Poco F6 series
 Poco X8s
 Poco X7
 Poco X6 Pro
 Poco M8s 5G
 Poco M7
 Poco C81 Pro
 Poco Pad C1
 HyperOS 4 follows in the footsteps of several other Android 17-based updates, giving the UI a Liquid Glass-inspired overhaul, more lockscreen customization (and giant clocks. We all love giant clocks, right?), new homescreen organization features, and better support for floating apps and app orientations.
 Xiaomi also touted HyperOS 4’s enhanced performance, which launches apps nearly 20% faster after about a day of using the phone. This is run by a background AI algorithm that figures out usage, which is not too dissimilar to Google’s old Adaptive Battery feature launched all the way back on Android 9 Pie. If you want to see the full list of updates, check out Xiaomi’s official HyperOS 4 page here .
